body:
https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/39069 rings a bell but not sure how it could affect you.

Do you see any logging related to UPX when building?

issue.title: Do not fail UPX if compression level is not given

body:
No there isn't any output regarding upx compression. The build step isn't  executed.

In the correct case (quarkus < 3.8.2) these are the executed steps:
JarResultBuildStep
NativeImageBuildStep
UpxCompressionBuildStep

In the failure case (quarkus >= 3.8.2) the steps are as follows:
JarResultBuildStep
NativeImageBuildStep
QuarkusAugmentor

The UpxCompressionBuildStep is simply missing.

Ah, yes, silly me!

That needs to go in the next patch release, thanks a lot for your report!
